job: Drafting the FAR amendment or solicitation clause that turns the voluntary cyber-benchmarking framework into a covered-model contracting condition.
outcome: A FAR amendment, agency acquisition rule, or standardized solicitation clause requiring covered-frontier-model vendors to attest to the cyber framework.
motivation: Executive-branch direction to operationalize the EO's procurement pull without new statute, mirroring prior secure-software self-attestation gates.

task.why: Convert voluntary framework into de facto seller requirement
task.how: FAR amendment modeled on CISA self-attestation

actor: covered-model designation and clearinghouse program lead
job: Standing up the cyber-capability benchmarking process, the covered-frontier-model designation list, and the AI Cybersecurity Clearinghouse agencies buy into.
outcome: An operational designation list plus clearinghouse that supplies the procurement gate its enforceable referent and federal buying leverage.
motivation: EO directs Treasury, NSA, and CISA to build the machinery that gives the attestation clause something concrete to require.

task.who: Treasury / NSA / CISA interagency program team
task.what: Build benchmarking, designation list, and clearinghouse
task.where: AI Cybersecurity Clearinghouse and federal critical-infrastructure systems
task.when: Runway before the acquisition clause finalizes
task.why: Give the procurement gate an enforceable designation referent
task.how: Offensive/defensive cyber-capability benchmarking, vuln scanning, patch distribution

job: Preparing benchmarking participation, early-access disclosure, and the public cyber attestation needed to keep selling covered models into federal use.
outcome: A published federal cyber attestation, or a clause-bound award, demonstrating participation in the benchmarking and disclosure process.
motivation: Federal buying power makes attestation a precondition for contract eligibility; non-participants get locked out of government revenue.

task.where: Federal solicitation responses and clearinghouse early-access track
task.why: Preserve eligibility to win federal frontier-model contracts
task.how: Cyber-capability benchmarking enrollment and disclosure submission
